arms.description: Independent direct S3 equation construction and exact Python integer-row W3 closure for 14 fixed named inputs, preceded by two already checked rank controls.

build: published retained D3 maps and independent C0-C3 checks

arms.description: Rerun two previously checked named exact W3 rank controls through the same pinned direct verifier before the 14 new inputs.

claims.text: For each of 14 fixed named original systems, the direct S3 Boolean W3 closure has the reported exact rank; equality with the retained checked quotient dimension proves its D3 map kernel equals W3. No D4, D5 or LFD result follows.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic GF2 ranks; no timed or variance claim.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No population null hypothesis; every retained quotient dimension is compared exactly, and mismatches are preserved.

positive.expected_detection: The two previously checked named controls reproduce ranks 8130 and 10970 and exact quotient dimensions 12746 and 12509 before any new item is accepted.

decision_rule.text: Accept a per-item exactness claim only after its direct closure exits zero, the equation-mask digest matches the published 16-item identity audit, and the resulting quotient dimension equals the retained independently checked D3 map dimension. Preserve all outcomes.
decision_rule.threshold: 2 controls agree; source/plan hashes match; each accepted item has exit0, exact rank and quotient equality

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoint; one total attempt per named item, preserve every completed row and interruption.

inadmissible: Inferring D4, D5 or LFD bounds from W3 dimension equality.
Discarding mismatched, failed, timed-out or unrun items.
Changing the fixed 16-input set or retaining only favorable ranks after output.
invalidation_rules: Source, frozen source-plan, equation audit or input hash mismatch prevents accepting the affected row.
Insufficient daily or monthly budget headroom, absent authorization, duplicate active work or expired deadline prevents launch.
Nonzero exit, timeout or incomplete JSON is inconclusive for that item.

literature.claim: Definition of Boolean W3 and exactness gate for a checked quotient.
